title: Paul-Lez/jacobian-conjecture
summary: A self-contained version of the formal-conjectures formalization by Paul Lezeau and Dean Cureton. It disproves the generalized Jacobian conjecture over every nontrivial commutative ring using an explicit determinant-one polynomial self-map in three variables. The formal-conjectures formalisation remains the reference statement.

formalizes.title: Hello there the Jacobian conjecture is false

review.reason: Self-contained Lean disproof of the generalized Jacobian conjecture over nontrivial commutative rings.
